verdict.rationale: Intel's Copilot+ integration language (docs-7, docs-15) gestures at AI assistance—voice commands to 'get answers, edit content'—but this is generic OS/app-level assistant marketing, not evidence of the chip itself surfacing insights or suggestions from a user's own data inside a product. Missing for 10: any concrete example of data-specific analysis/insight generation, first-party feature demo, or independent hands-on verification of such a capability tied to this SKU.
